verdict.rationale: dlt ships its own dbt runner and advertises end-to-end dlt→dbt pipelines, so dbt can run inside the same Python pipeline as the load. dltHub orchestration also claims chaining and lineage-aware runs, which points to load-triggered sequencing rather than a timer. However, the evidence never states that dbt runs automatically after a successful load, or only on newly loaded data, so the event-driven half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that dbt runs are triggered by load completion rather than a schedule, detail on how loaded data or incremental state is passed to dbt, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer
